title: wt config --json
description: The resolved repository configuration, including branch naming resolved through user overrides. Schema 1: fields may be added and enumerations may gain values; nothing is renamed or removed. See docs/json.md.

mainRoot.description: The absolute path of the main checkout, including when called from a linked worktree.

configured.description: A repository configuration file exists and parses; false for detected defaults.

trunk.description: The resolved trunk branch; null when absent.

trunkSource.description: How trunk was found, with the same meanings as status.v1.json.

typeSuffix.description: The suffix used in worktree directory names.

branchSuffix.description: The resolved branch suffix, including user overrides; null when empty.

typeNames.description: Resolved type-to-name overrides; an empty object when none are set.

developerConfigDirs.description: Repository-relative directory entries exactly as configured; empty is [].

developerConfigFiles.description: Repository-relative file entries exactly as configured; empty is [].

cacheDirs.description: Repository-relative cache entries exactly as configured; empty is [].

provisionScript.description: The current checkout has an executable bin/worktree/provision.sh file.
